title: Ing Siyam a Siglu ning Pamaus
intro: Ilarawan mung makatalakad kang magdili-dili laban keng alun ning pamaglibak para mas makaba kesa keng pamagtas at pangabagsak da reng imperyu, mamaus bengi at aldo kabang makatakap la reng balugbug ampo makabalut la reng imalan. king mumuna atin yang saken a mitalakad keng malanging gabun ampo danum a e na kalupa ning nanu mang ikit. Aramdaman mu ing pasensya keng likod na niting marathon ning imbitasyun?
clues: Agkatan ku la ding memalen ku bengi at aldo, king lihim at makabuklat, ban samban de ing Allah mung bukud.
Sinuksuk da la ring taliri da ring memalen ku karing balugbug da at binalut da la ring imalan da king sarili da ban kawani da ku.
Menatili ku kareng tau ku kilub ning siam a ralan at limang pulung banua a mamaus karela king patnube.
ginawa kung lulanan lalam ning mata ning Allah ampo ing kapahayagan na kabang ding tau ku pagmulalan da ku keng malanging gabun.
Inutus da kanaku ing magdala kung pares a miyayaliwang uri at ding talasalpantaya nung datang ing utus at ing hurno maglaso ya.
linawe ku kareng alun a tatas kalupa da reng bunduk kabang ing albug lulub no reng e bisa, kabang i Allah linigtas no reng atyu keng ark.

outcome.label: Kelabasan
options: Mesira la ding memalen ku king marimlang angin kilub ning pitung bengi
Ding tatanggi linub la king Maragul a Albug at ding talasalpantaya miligtas la
Mesira la ding memalen ku king metung a masikan a sabog king metung a abak
Meging unggoy la ding memalen ku uli na ning kapanalangsangan da
Melaklak la ding memalen ku king yatu uli na ning ketasan lub
outcome.answer: Ding tatanggi linub la king Maragul a Albug at ding talasalpantaya miligtas la

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًۭا
verse: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day. (71:5)
